result.rationale: The rescue objective stalls at 0/2 across all 6 turns despite the team repeatedly moving toward civilians. The dominant causal blocker is spatial/hostile pressure: Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt (29 dmg turn 1, 25 dmg turn 2) while transiting power-junction/storage, dropping to 36 health; Medic Reyes's escort of civilian-sato is contested at turn 4 (target_zone_capacity_lost) when moving through junction-cover, and the reactor-instability hazard bleeds health (Chen 110→70, Imani 46→36) while reactor-heat climbs to 100. The team's route to the rescue-airlock extraction point is blocked by capacity contestation and hostile presence (Raider Holt at junction-cover/command-deck), so the useful rescue affordance never becomes actionable. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information gap (knowledge is well-revealed) or a local policy failure (the agent does attempt rescue actions).
